claim_card.objects: An arbitrary measurable probability sample space and preaction sigma algebra, a finite measurable action set, an arbitrary measurable observation space, a history-measurable Markov policy kernel and action-conditioned Markov observation kernel, recorded actions/observations, and predictable bounded tests.
claim_card.hypotheses: Literal joint-law factorization is the experimental randomization assumption. The selected target action has recorded real propensity at least a fixed strictly positive rulewise c at every time/context. Tests are predictable in context and lie pointwise in [0,1]. For the simultaneous sequential statement the rule family is Countable, positive NNReal budgets are summable to at most delta<=1, and actions/observations are recorded at the next filtration level.
claim_card.conclusion: The actual importance-weighted observation has actual conditional expectation equal almost everywhere to its action-conditioned observation-kernel integral and lies in [0,1/c]. The actual measurable accumulated contextual-mean event has probability at least 1-delta simultaneously over all registered rules and positive finite times, with the exact P66 boundary multiplied by 1/c.
claim_card.scope: Contextual one-step quantities along encountered histories. No reset-population or alternate long-run-policy distribution is identified.

Specialization of the same pathwise event -> arbitrary data-selected registered rule and positive finite time.

obligations.item: Genuine experiment rather than assumed CE
obligations.evidence: Experiment fields are actual policy/observation kernels, their Markov properties, recorded-coordinate measurability, and a literal equality of joint measures. No conditional expectation identity or concentration conclusion is a field.
integral_weightedTest uses actual integral_compProd followed by integral_fintype; only target a survives the finite sum, and c>0 makes its real propensity nonzero before division cancellation.

obligations.item: Actual conditional expectation on arbitrary spaces
obligations.evidence: evidence_condExp applies ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq. It proves integrability from explicit bounds and identifies every measurable preaction set integral using trim, compProd and the actual recorded joint-law map. No regular conditional distribution or Standard Borel premise is introduced.

The test is measurable for the preaction sigma algebra times observations. Propensity is measurable for that same preaction algebra. evidence_measurable_at derives next-level evidence measurability from recorded actions/observations.
weightedTest_mem_Icc derives the exact [0,1/c] interval using pointwise [0,1] tests and c<=propensity with c>0. There is no division-by-zero inference or unweighted unit bound.

obligations.item: Actual contextual target and simultaneous AE replacement
obligations.evidence: kernelMeanProcess is literally the action-conditioned observation-kernel integral at the encountered context. centeredSum_eq_kernelSum_ae uses Countable J and countable times to replace every actual conditional mean on one common full-measure event.

covered_adaptive_action_certificate invokes the proved P66 interval theorem on actual weighted evidence with width1/c, then transfers by measure_mono_ae. covered_event_measurable separately proves measurability of the literal contextual event. Exact prospective alpha budgets and positive-time indexing are retained.

covered_bound_at_selected_time specializes the already simultaneous event at an arbitrary selected registered rule and positive finite time; it creates no new confidence budget or optional-stopping premise.

Actual Markov experiments have equal observed pair laws for a never-selected action but different target kernel means. A half-coverage action produces evidence2 with actual pair mass1/2. These are genuine on-support obstructions, not unconstrained numerical witnesses.
